'''''Herniaria''''' is a genus of flowering plants in the family [[Caryophyllaceae]] known generally as '''ruptureworts'''.<ref>[https://plants.usda.gov/java/profile?symbol=HERNI USDA Plants Profile: Species in North America]</ref> They are native to Eurasia and Africa but several species have been widely introduced to other continents. These are flat, mat-forming annual herbs.<ref>[https://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?2907,2947 Jepson Manual Treatment]</ref> The genus gets its scientific and common names from the once-held belief that species could be used as an herbal remedy for [[hernia]]s.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=115180 Flora of North America]</ref>
